name: prized
description: Give Codex a cloud dev box: it copies your project to a Prized box, a Linux machine that stays on, and keeps working there with your laptop closed. Runs the prized CLI on your computer.

interface.longDescription:
Prized gives your coding agent a cloud dev box: a Linux machine of your own that stays on, so Codex and long jobs keep running after you close your laptop.

With this plugin, Codex uses the prized command-line tool on your computer to:
- start a box, or pick one of the boxes on your Prized account
- copy your project to the box once, with no sync, and set Codex up there
- run tests, builds and other long jobs on the box, or hand Codex a task there and walk away
- check on the box and its jobs, and pause, resume, resize or delete a box you name

It asks you before it installs the CLI, copies your project or any sign-in, or does anything that costs money, and it acts only on the box you name.

Who it is for: developers who use Codex and want it, their builds and their test runs to keep working on a machine that is always on.

Limitations: desktop only. The plugin runs the prized CLI in a local thread, so it needs the ChatGPT desktop app or Codex on macOS, Linux or Windows, and a Prized account (sign up at prized.dev). It does not create or control boxes from ChatGPT on the web or on a phone. Boxes run in Prized's cloud and are billed to your Prized account; Codex itself runs on your own ChatGPT plan or OpenAI API key.
capabilities: Copy a project to a box
Run long jobs and Codex tasks on a box
Check, pause, resume and resize boxes
defaultPrompt: Put this project on a Prized box and run its tests there.
Keep working on this task on my Prized box while my laptop is closed.
Is my Prized box running, and is the job on it done?

publication.release_notes: First release: the prized-boxes skill, which has Codex create a Prized box, copy the project to it once, run long jobs and Codex tasks there, and check on, pause, resume and resize the box.
